name: Moli v1.1 Headless Browser for AI Agents (CDP)
description: Token-protected Rust headless browser for AI agents: CDP and WebDriver.

upstream.moli: lexmount/moli v1.1.22 (released 2026-11-06, commit 2353bc83), prebuilt Linux release archives, SHA-256 pinned
upstream.node: Node.js 24.22.2 LTS (2026-10-27), nodejs.org tarball, SHA-256 pinned

MOLI_TOKEN.description: Access token, generated at deploy. Send it as ?token=, Authorization: Bearer or Basic auth password. 16+ chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -

PORT.description: Port of the token gate (healthcheck and public domain target). Moli itself listens on 127.0.0.1:9222 only.

MOLI_MODE.description: layout: real layout, screenshots and coordinate clicks on demand (default). dom: DOM only, cheapest. full: layout plus images, fonts and media.

MOLI_BLOCK_PRIVATE_NETWORKS.description: Block pages from reaching private, loopback and link-local addresses (Railway private network, metadata IP). Set false only to browse your own private services.

MOLI_MAX_SESSIONS.description: Maximum open WebSocket sessions (CDP or BiDi connections); more get HTTP 429. 0 = unlimited.

MOLI_IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: Close a WebSocket session after this many seconds without traffic in either direction. 0 = never.

MOLI_SESSION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum lifetime of a WebSocket session in seconds, idle or not. 0 = unlimited.

MOLI_LOG_LEVEL.description: Moli log level: debug, info, warn, error or fatal. The gate always logs sessions at info.

MOLI_EXTRA_ARGS.description: Optional extra flags for moli serve, quoted like a shell, e.g. --user-agent "MyAgent/1.0" or --http-proxy socks5://host:1080. --host and --port are reserved.

BROWSER_TOKEN.description: Alias of MOLI_TOKEN under the name Railway's Browserless templates use.

BROWSER_WS_ENDPOINT.description: Public CDP WebSocket URL for Playwright connectOverCDP, Puppeteer browserWSEndpoint or browser-use. Reference as ${{Moli.BROWSER_WS_ENDPOINT}}.

BROWSER_WS_ENDPOINT_PRIVATE.description: CDP WebSocket URL over Railway's private network (no egress). Reference as ${{Moli.BROWSER_WS_ENDPOINT_PRIVATE}} from services in this project.

BROWSER_WEBDRIVER_ENDPOINT.description: Public WebDriver (Selenium) URL. Authenticate with Basic auth (any user, password MOLI_TOKEN) or a Bearer header; browserName moli.

BROWSER_WEBDRIVER_ENDPOINT_PRIVATE.description: WebDriver URL over Railway's private network, same authentication as the public one.
